claims: C1 unless the cost of making the wrong assumption is too high or the task is too ambiguous or difficult with available information, the assistant typically should take a stab at fulfilling the request and tell the user it could be more helpful with certain information
C2 when feasible, asking clarifying questions and proceeding with preliminary actions should happen concurrently to avoid unnecessary delays

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text speaks of the assistant without defining it

concepts.name: fulfills_request
concepts.gloss: R is a response that fulfills the request of assistant A
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of taking a stab at fulfilling the request, so a relation between a response and the assistant who fulfills it must exist

concepts.name: too_costly_wrong_assumption
concepts.gloss: R is a response for which the cost of making the wrong assumption is too high
concepts.inference: the clause's exception condition names the cost of making the wrong assumption; whether it is too high is a fact about the case

concepts.name: too_ambiguous_or_difficult
concepts.gloss: R is a response for which the task is too ambiguous or difficult with available information
concepts.inference: the clause's exception condition names ambiguity or difficulty with available information; whether it holds is a fact about the case

concepts.name: asks_clarifying_questions
concepts.gloss: Q is a clarifying question asked by assistant A
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of asking clarifying questions, so a relation between a question and the assistant who asks it must exist

concepts.name: feasible
concepts.gloss: Q is a clarifying question that is feasible to ask
concepts.inference: the clause conditions the obligation on feasibility, so feasibility must be a fact about the case

concepts.name: preliminary_actions
concepts.gloss: A is a preliminary action the assistant proceeds with
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of proceeding with preliminary actions, so a relation between an action and the assistant who proceeds with it must exist

asserts.read_back: the assistant typically should take a stab at fulfilling the request and tell the user it could be more helpful with certain information, unless the cost of a wrong assumption is too high or the task is too ambiguous or difficult with available information
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), fulfills_request(R, A), not too_costly_wrong_assumption(R), not too_ambiguous_or_difficult(R)

asserts.read_back: when feasible, asking clarifying questions should happen concurrently with preliminary actions to avoid unnecessary delays
when feasible, proceeding with preliminary actions should happen concurrently with asking clarifying questions to avoid unnecessary delays

closure.reason: the clause obliges taking a stab only when the cost of a wrong assumption is not too high and the task is not too ambiguous or difficult; it does not forbid taking a stab in other cases, so silence permits
the clause obliges asking clarifying questions when feasible; it does not forbid asking them when not feasible, so silence permits
the clause obliges proceeding with preliminary actions when feasible; it does not forbid proceeding when not feasible, so silence permits
